docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF APR-27-2009 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF BOYDEN-DESHAZER, CHRISTOPHER RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT BOYD, DEEDRA $400.06 PRINCIPAL, TOTAL JUDGMENT $400.06, THE COURT FINDS TENANCY WAS FOR A FIXED TERM OF 18 DAYS AND DID NOT BECOME A MONTH-TO-MONTH TENANCY AT THE END OF ITS TERM.THEREFORE, PLTF IS ENTITLED TO RETURN OF THE ADDITIONAL RENT WITHHELD FROM THE SECURITY DEPOSIT BECAUSE NO NOTICE WAS REQUIRED TO TERMINATE THE TENANCY AT THE END OF ITS TERM (E.G. SAN FRANCISCO ADMINISTRATIVE CODE 37.2(R)(1), ET. CETERA).PLTF OWED $599.94 (18X$33.33) FOR PAST RENT DUE. THE REMAINDER OF THE $1000 SECURITY DEPOSIT SHOULD BE RETURNED TO PLTF BY DEFT.
